name: Quark
author: trix@noreply.com
description: Quark - high-performance Minecraft: Bedrock server software derived from PocketMine-MP and Axolotl. PM5 / PHP 8.4 / Linux x86_64 only. Installs the Bedrock-Phanatics PHP 8.4 runtime and builds Quark from the chosen branch, tag or commit.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Builds Quark from QUARK_REF with the Bedrock-Phanatics PHP runtime. Everything is prepared in a work
# directory first, so a failed reinstall leaves the previous runtime and Quark.phar untouched.
set -euo pipefail

PHP_RELEASE=https://github.com/Bedrock-Phanatics/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/qrk6-php-8.4-latest
PHP_ARCHIVE=PHP-8.4-Linux-x86_64-PM5-hosting.tar.gz
REPO=https://github.com/Bedrock-Phanatics/Quark.git

ref=${QUARK_REF:-main}
server=/mnt/server
# Wings gives /tmp only 100 MB, so build on the server volume
work=$server/.quark-build

cleanup() {
    status=$?
    rm -rf "$work"
    [ "$status" = 0 ] || printf '\n*** Quark installation FAILED (exit %s). Fix the error above and reinstall. ***\n' "$status" >&2
}
trap cleanup EXIT
fail() { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
dl() { curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$@"; }

[[ $ref =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$ && $ref != *..* ]] || fail "QUARK_REF must be a branch, tag or commit"
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "the Quark PHP runtime only supports Linux x86_64 (detected $(uname -m))"

echo "==> Installing build dependencies"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates tar >/dev/null

rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -p "$work"
cd "$work"

echo "==> Downloading the PHP 8.4 runtime"
dl -o php.tar.gz "$PHP_RELEASE/$PHP_ARCHIVE"
dl -o SHA256SUMS "$PHP_RELEASE/SHA256SUMS"
expected=$(awk -v a="$PHP_ARCHIVE" '$2 == a || $2 == "./" a { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS)
[ -n "$expected" ] || fail "$PHP_ARCHIVE is missing from SHA256SUMS"
echo "$expected  php.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status || fail "PHP runtime checksum mismatch"
tar -xzf php.tar.gz --no-same-owner
rm -f php.tar.gz SHA256SUMS
[ -x ./bin/php7/bin/php ] || fail "PHP runtime extraction failed: ./bin/php7/bin/php was not found"

echo "Configuring PHP extension directory..."
EXTENSION_DIR="$(find bin -type d -name '*debug-zts*' -print -quit)"
[ -n "$EXTENSION_DIR" ] || fail "unable to locate the PHP extension directory"
# The runtime lives in the work directory while building and in /home/container afterwards
export QUARK_SERVER_ROOT=$work
EXTENSION_DIR="\${QUARK_SERVER_ROOT:-/home/container}/$EXTENSION_DIR"
PHP_INI=./bin/php7/bin/php.ini
if grep -q '^extension_dir' "$PHP_INI"; then
    sed -i "s|^extension_dir=.*|extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"|" "$PHP_INI"
else
    echo "extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"" >> "$PHP_INI"
fi
php=$work/bin/php7/bin/php

echo "Installing Composer..."
dl -o composer-setup.php https://getcomposer.org/installer
"$php" composer-setup.php --install-dir="$work" --filename=composer.phar --quiet
rm -f composer-setup.php
export COMPOSER_HOME=$work/composer COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1

echo "==> Fetching Quark $ref"
git init -q src
git -C src fetch -q --depth 1 "$REPO" "$ref"
git -C src checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
echo "commit $(git -C src rev-parse HEAD)"

echo "==> Building Quark"
(cd src && "$php" "$work/composer.phar" run-script make-server --no-interaction)
[ -s src/Quark.phar ] || fail "the build did not produce Quark.phar"

echo "==> Installing"
cd "$server"
unset QUARK_SERVER_ROOT
rm -rf bin.old
if [ -e bin ]; then mv bin bin.old; fi
mv "$work/bin" bin
rm -rf bin.old
mv -f "$work/src/Quark.phar" Quark.phar
rm -f PocketMine-MP.phar

echo "==> Quark $ref installed"
